name: Hassan Rouhani
summary: A centrist cleric within the Islamic Republic, Rouhani campaigned on moderation, engagement abroad and citizens' rights, and concluded the 2015 nuclear deal. He rejects nuclear weapons, force for expansion and religious war, is hostile to Israel and US pressure, and issued a non-binding Charter on Citizens' Rights.

abolish-ip.rationale: He said it is his government's policy to protect intellectual property rights; Charter Art. 76 also protects them.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: In 2019 he called the addition of the Golan to the other occupied territories doomed and treated it as occupation.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: In 2016 he named fiscal and financial discipline with low inflation as the policy for economic stability and investment.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Charter Art. 10 prohibits causing hatred against followers of other faiths.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: He called terrorism and the killing of innocent persons the ultimate inhumanity and condemned drone strikes against innocents.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The Charter on Citizens' Rights, issued by Rouhani, opens by saying the durability of a state's legitimacy and authority is guaranteed through the consent of its citizens; his 2013 UN speech rests legitimacy on the ballot box.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: He rejected imposing Western values as universal and the division of the world into a "superior us" and "inferior other".

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Charter Art. 2 gives a right to a decent life and its necessities, and Arts. 86-87 social security and unemployment benefits.

democratic-peace.rationale: In 2016 he said uprooting violence in the region requires promoting democracy, citizenship rights and economic development.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: He praised Iran's mix of ethnicities and religions and Charter Art. 96 says cultural diversity is to be respected.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Charter Arts. 7-8 make all citizens equally entitled to dignity and legal privileges and forbid undue discrimination; Art. 77 bars discrimination on ethnicity, religion or gender in work.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He praised Iran as a mix of diverse religions and ethnicities and a bastion of tolerance.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Charter Art. 57 establishes presumption of innocence, the right to defence and trial by a competent court.

free-public-college.rationale: Charter Art. 104 provides free education to the end of secondary school and says the government will expand free higher education as needed.

free-trade-promotes-peace.rationale: In 2015 he said mutual economic ties are the foremost factor in facilitating political cooperation and reducing security challenges, and that economic engagement leads to security.

future-generations.rationale: Charter Art. 111, the section on the environment, ties the right to a healthy environment to today's and future generations.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: As president he concluded the 2015 JCPOA, which curbed Iran's nuclear programme in return for eased sanctions.

initiating-nondefensive-force-unjustifie.rationale: He called the military option illegal and ineffective and said Iran uses force for defence only.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: He calls Israel a rogue regime whose people are "usurpers" of Palestinian land and says one group cannot take another's land after Nazi crimes.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Charter Art. 91 asserts a right to an environment free of narcotics, with rehabilitation for addicts.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: He praised the martyrdom of Iran's nuclear scientists and honoured oppressed martyrs.

military-force-for-human-rights.rationale: In 2013 he said expansionist aims cannot be hidden behind humanitarian rhetoric and that any threat or use of force will worsen the Syrian crisis.

minority-language-support.rationale: Charter Art. 101 gives citizens the right to learn, use and teach their own local language and dialect.

more-religion-public.rationale: Charter Art. 6 commits the government to use its powers to foster an environment for religious and ethical virtue.

nation-first.rationale: He said multilateralism and win-win solutions that take both parties' interests into account should be the basis of international engagement.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Charter Arts. 68-71 require licences and public contracts to follow fair competition and a transparent, competitively fair business environment.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: He said regional security comes when American troops pull out and that coalitions under foreign forces' command interfere in the region.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: He said no nation should possess nuclear weapons and called for a nuclear-weapon-free Middle East and world.

open-government-data.rationale: Charter Arts. 30 and 69 require public bodies to publish information and to announce economic decisions and changes transparently.

party-controls-media.rationale: Charter Art. 29 says no authority may pressure the press or media or censor or control publications; he told CNN the government must be open to criticism.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: He sponsored the UN initiative "A World Against Violence and Extremism" and said there are no violent solutions to world crises.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Charter Art. 98 commits the government to protect and conserve civilizational and cultural heritage.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Charter Art. 57 requires nullum crimen sine lege and judgments issued on relevant laws by an independent court.

property-fundamental.rationale: Charter Art. 75 says no one may dispossess citizens of property save pursuant to the law.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Charter Art. 30 gives citizens the right to access public information and obliges organs to publish unclassified information.

racial-franchise.rationale: Charter Art. 43 gives all citizens the right to form and join political parties and Arts. 7-8 equality without discrimination.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Charter Art. 8 forbids undue discrimination and Art. 77 discrimination on ethnicity or religion.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: He said Iran will never export its revolution or impose its religion by force of arms, and spreads them by engaging minds.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: Charter Arts. 7-10 give all ethnicities equal dignity and forbid insulting or discriminating against them.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: In 2019 he honoured Hossein's movement and all freedom seekers who do not bow to oppression and bear hardship in the struggle.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Charter Art. 10 prohibits insulting, degrading or inciting hatred against ethnicities, faiths and social and political groups.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: He presents the Constitutional and Islamic revolutions as legitimate risings against dictatorship.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: He describes Israel as taking Palestinian land by usurpation and occupation, which matches a settler-colonial description, though he does not use the term.

social-market-economy.rationale: His government's stated policy is a competitive, investment-friendly business environment (2017), with Charter rights to welfare and social security.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Charter Art. 75 and the preamble bind all authorities to law; no person or authority may override citizens' rights save by law.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Charter Arts. 25 and 28 protect freedom of belief and the right to criticize the government, and require the government to promote a culture of accepting criticism.

territorial-expansion.rationale: He said Iran does not seek to restore its ancient empire, has not attacked anyone in 200 years and arms only for defence.

torture-always-illegal.rationale: Charter Art. 60 declares physical or psychological torture and forced testimony violations, legally prosecutable, with results inadmissible.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: He said regional security will be realised when American troops pull out of the region.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Charter Art. 2 gives citizens a right to appropriate medical treatment and access to medicines, and Art. 86 public welfare and social security.

women-suffrage.rationale: Charter Art. 11 gives women the right to active participation in policymaking, legislation and management, with equal social opportunities "in accordance with Islamic norms".

notes: Themes searched: government and rights (Charter), world and nuclear (UN speeches, CNN), economy (UN 2017, Charter), society (Charter). No separate record sources on executions or the 2019 internet shutdown were used because the judiciary and the national security council, not Rouhani alone, acted; those stay null. Statements on which the sources are silent are null.
